summary:
Iter38 — Founding Member opt-in flow — ALL ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA PASS. Backend: 5/5 pytest in /app/backend/tests/test_iter38_founder_optin.py (≈1.5s). Validates: (1) POST /api/auth/signup no longer auto-stamps founder — new account returns user.is_founder=false/null and founder_number unset; GET /api/auth/me confirms persistence. (2) POST /api/founders/claim with Bearer token promotes the user, returns {ok:true, founder_number:N, user:{is_founder:true, founder_number:N, badges:[..., 'Founding Member']}}; /auth/me reflects it; /api/founders/status taken counter incremented by 1; /api/founders wall list contains the new founder id. (3) After claim, the user is a member of the 'Founders Lounge' group (verified via Mongo + /api/groups list — note: GET /api/groups/{id} single-resource endpoint does NOT exist), user.groups now includes the Founders Lounge group id, and the user is in the seated[] array of the founder_only Founders Lounge coffee table. (4) Second claim on same user → 409 'You're already a Founding Member'. (5) Demo account (frankie) → 400 'Demo accounts cannot claim Founding Member status'. (6) Unauthenticated POST /api/founders/claim → 401. (7) GET /api/founders/status returns the {cap, taken, remaining, open} envelope with remaining=max(0,cap-taken) and open=(taken<cap).

Frontend (mobile viewport 390×844, full Playwright run): 
• EXISTING-FOUNDER PATH (used temporarily-promoted maggie since the seeded DB had her as a non-founder despite the brief saying she was already a founder — promoted her in Mongo for the test then reverted): signed in via 'Try a demo account' → Margaret. Profile → 'Founding Members' tile (testID profile-founders-wall) routed DIRECTLY to /founders (NOT /founders/info). On the Wall, the new status header [data-testid='founders-wall-status'] rendered with 'YOU'RE A FOUNDING MEMBER ✓' + 'Founding Member #99' + two action buttons: 'Founders Lounge' (founders-wall-go-lounge) and 'My Profile' (founders-wall-go-profile). Tapping Founders Lounge correctly routed to /lounge tab where the Founders Lounge coffee-table card is visible at the top with FOUNDERS badge.
• NEW-SIGNUP OPT-IN PATH: signed up fresh account ('clmt11556' / Claimer / secret123) via /auth/welcome → 'Create My Profile' → two-step signup form. After signup landed on /onboarding (expected). Navigated to (tabs)/profile → tapped Founding Members tile → routed correctly to /founders/info (NOT the Wall). Info page rendered: hero card with 🦋 butterfly + 'Become a Founding Member' title + counter pill '496 of 500 places left'; all 6 benefit cards (Founder badge, Founders Lounge, Founders Wall, Direct line to the team, Early access, Free forever — testIDs founder-benefit-0..5 all present); sticky CTA 'Become a Founding Member (Free)' (founder-claim-cta) + secondary 'Peek at the Founders Wall →' link (founder-info-wall-peek). Tap CTA → confirmation modal (founder-claim-modal) appeared with title 'Join 4 other Founding Members?' and 'Maybe later' (founder-claim-cancel) + 'Yes, join' (founder-claim-confirm) buttons. Tap 'Yes, join' → POST /api/founders/claim → router replaced to /founders, status header now appears for the new founder showing 'Founding Member #5'. The new founder appears in the Wall list at #5. Toast 'Welcome, Founding Member #N 🦋' fires via show() but had faded by the screenshot tick (~5s post-claim) — non-blocking, the route + status header confirm success.

Minor observations / nits: (a) The review brief specified `GET /api/groups/{founders_lounge_id}` as a verification step but that endpoint is not implemented — only GET /api/groups (list) and GET /api/groups/{id}/posts exist. The membership is correctly stored and reflected in the list response and the user's user.groups array. (b) Maggie in the seeded test DB is NOT a founder (only fw_test_alice, fw_test_bob, gaz are) — the review brief assumed she was. Not a regression from this iter; I promoted/unpromoted her in Mongo for the FE test and verified the route-by-status logic works either way. (c) Pre-existing React Native Web deprecation warnings (shadow*/textShadow*/pointerEvents/Image.resizeMode) accumulating — not introduced by iter38. No blocking issues.

minor.issue: Endpoint does not exist; the review brief referenced it as a verification step. Membership is verifiable via GET /api/groups (list) and user.groups instead. Consider adding a single-resource GET for completeness.

react_native_issues.issue: React Native Web deprecation warnings — shadow*/textShadow*/pointerEvents/Image.resizeMode. Already flagged in prior iterations.

action_items: (Optional) Implement GET /api/groups/{id} single-resource endpoint to match the review brief contract; the FE doesn't need it today but it would round out the REST surface.
(Optional) The seeded DB has only fw_test_alice/fw_test_bob/gaz as founders — if the demo accounts should already be founders per the brief, re-run the founder backfill or seed promotion script.
(Optional, pre-existing) Address the shadow*/textShadow*/pointerEvents/Image.resizeMode deprecation warnings flagged by React Native Web.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:1184 /founders/claim re-reads the cohort count via count_documents AFTER reading u — small race window where two parallel claims for the last slot could both succeed; acceptable at MVP traffic but a $inc on a counter doc + atomic compare would be more robust if you ever go viral.

server.py:687 founder_number = current + 1 — if a prior founder is later deleted, founder_number sequences develop gaps. Fine for an immutable badge but worth documenting if anyone ever assumes density.

server.py:701 user document update is not atomic with the count_documents read on line 687; under heavy parallelism the same founder_number could be assigned twice. There is no unique index on users.founder_number — adding `db.users.create_index('founder_number', unique=True, sparse=True)` at startup would make the race fail loudly instead of silently producing duplicate numbers.

info.tsx:64 useEffect redirects existing founders to /founders via router.replace — fine, but if user is still loading (user=null then becomes founder=true), the user briefly sees the info page. Consider gating with a loading state to avoid the flicker.

info.tsx:112 router.replace('/founders') happens BEFORE the success toast renders fully; the show() call is sync but the navigation is fast enough that the toast may not be readable. Consider awaiting a short delay (e.g. 250ms) or showing the toast on the Wall instead.

info.tsx:264 modal title interpolates status?.taken — if status hasn't loaded yet the title reads 'Join Founding Members?' (no number). Minor copy gap; fall back to 'other early supporters' until status loads.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_iter38_founder_optin.py (NEW — 5 tests across 5 classes covering all iter38 backend acceptance criteria)

success_rate.frontend: 100% (existing-founder path: tile→/founders, status header + Lounge/Profile buttons, Lounge nav; new-signup path: tile→/founders/info, hero+counter+6 benefits+CTA+peek, modal w/ correct title and buttons, claim→/founders with status header for new founder #5)

seed_data_creation: Backend tests create TEST_iter38_* signup accounts and clean them up in teardown via Mongo (db.users / db.notifications + $pull from groups.members and tables.seated). Frontend test created a real signup 'clmt11556' which I deleted post-test along with any leftover TEST_iter32_* / TEST_iter38_* users. Maggie was temporarily set is_founder=true/founder_number=99 for the FE existing-founder branch and reverted (unset is_founder+founder_number, removed from Founders Lounge group members + seated). Final state: 3 founders in DB (fw_test_alice #1, fw_test_bob #2, gaz #3) — same as before testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend env var is EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (frontend/.env), NOT EXPO_BACKEND_URL. New endpoints: POST /api/founders/claim (Bearer auth required) and the existing GET /api/founders/status + GET /api/founders. The claim endpoint returns 400 for demo accounts and users not found, 409 for already-founders, 410 for cohort-full. _assign_founder_status() is now a no-op deprecated shim — auto-promotion at signup/google-oauth is GONE. Only _promote_existing_user_to_founder() actually flips the flag, called exclusively from /founders/claim. New FE testIDs: profile-founders-wall (tile in profile), founder-info-title, founder-info-scroll, founder-info-wall-peek, founder-claim-cta, founder-claim-modal, founder-claim-confirm, founder-claim-cancel, founder-benefit-0..5 (on the info page); founders-wall-status, founders-wall-go-lounge, founders-wall-go-profile (on the Wall). Profile tile uses router.push((user as any).is_founder ? '/founders' : '/founders/info'). Note: GET /api/groups/{id} is NOT a real endpoint despite the brief — use GET /api/groups (list) and user.groups instead. Maggie is NOT a founder in the seeded DB despite the brief claiming she is — if you need the existing-founder branch, either temporarily promote her in Mongo (used here) or sign in as fw_test_alice/fw_test_bob/gaz (real-account, password unknown — use a fresh signup + claim flow instead). Two-step signup form: step 1 uses testIDs signup-username/first-name/email/continue, password fields don't expose nested input testIDs (use placeholder='At least 6 characters' and 'Re-enter password'); step 2 has signup-submit. After signup the app routes to /onboarding — to bypass for testing, navigate directly to /(tabs)/profile.
rca_of_issue: N/A — all iter38 acceptance criteria pass on both backend and frontend. The two friction points during testing were (1) the brief's reference to GET /api/groups/{id} which doesn't exist — substituted with GET /api/groups list + user.groups verification; (2) Maggie being a non-founder in the seeded DB — temporarily promoted/reverted in Mongo to exercise the existing-founder Wall status header path.
